fraud.text:
(xi)
(a)	During the course of our examination of the books and records of the company carried out in accordance with generally accepted auditing practices in India and according the information and explanation given to us, we have neither come across any instance of fraud on or by the company, noticed or reported during the year, nor we have been informed of such case by the management.

timeline.summary: ICRA downgrades bank loan ratings of subsidiaries Woodpecker Distilleries and Som Distilleries Odisha to BBB from BBB+.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹458.21 Cr (-32.9% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹55.75 Cr.
Jagdish Kumar Arora, promoter, declared no new encumbrances for Som Distilleries & Breweries Limited as of 31.03.2026 under SEBI Regulation 31(4).
2026-06-02: Som Distilleries reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,233 Cr and guided for ₹1,400-1,500 Cr revenue in FY27.
On 2026-10-30, the Supreme Court of India reaffirmed the High Court order for the renewal of Som Distilleries' manufacturing licences, enabling the resumption of Bhopal plant operations.
Som Distilleries receives manufacturing licences for its Bhopal Plant from the Madhya Pradesh Excise Department.
